Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning retail license fees for retailers when selling for resale.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to retail license fees for retailers when sellingfor resale; and adding a new section to chapter 66.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning on the effective date of this section, the licenseissuance fee under RCW 66.24.630(4) does not apply to any spiritsretail licensee with respect to sales of spirits in original containersto retailers licensed to sell spirits for consumption on the premises.
